items.title: Take action
items.text: Start with starter projects and grow into deeper research and collaboration.

whatYouCan.pathTitle: How to engage in wetland protection
steps: Grasp why wetlands matter—climate, biodiversity, and water security.
Pick a track: starter, advanced, or expert collaboration.
Connect with mentors and learn methods from leading scientists.
Observe wetlands near you and build real questions from your place.
Share findings and stories to turn care into long-term action.
whatYouCan.quote: Wetland protection grows stronger with youth. The next journey begins in the real world.
whatYouCan.quoteSub: The platform combines outreach, research training, and mentors to help you turn concern into lasting action.
